chunks: Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: Are the salat of fear and the salat of travel both shortened?
He said: "Yes, and the salat of fear is more deserving of being shortened than the salat of travel, because in it there is fear."

key_terms.خَوْفًا: fear, which is the reason mentioned for the ruling
key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْخَوْفِ: the prayer performed in a state of fear or danger

ai.seo_question: Are both the prayer of fear and the prayer of travel shortened in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states that both the salat of fear and the salat of travel are shortened. It further emphasizes that the salat of fear has an even stronger basis for shortening because it is performed under conditions of fear.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1339 – Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):
I asked him about the prayer of fear and the prayer of travel—are both to be shortened?
Imam (as) said: "Yes, and the prayer of fear is more deserving of being shortened than the prayer of travel because it involves fear”.
